about: What the home page shows a visitor (Dinis, 6 November 2026: a home page to share, for us and for new people: what we write, what we have made, and the agents in action). Kept by designer@web-summit.dinis; rendered by admin/build/home.mjs ({{shots}}, {{writing}}, {{made}}). Screenshots taken on 6 November 2026 from this site's own pages, the key box and the menus hidden; each links to the live page.

shots.title: The team as one picture
shots.text: Seven people (and two who work with us), each ringed by their own AI agents. A filled dot has committed work; the grey curves are the messages agents send each other.

shots.title: Every scheduled run, today
shots.text: Each row is an agent on a timer: a green dot is a run that did work, a crossed dot a run that found nothing to do.

shots.title: Replay the week
shots.text: Angelo's command centre plays back every commit since 2 November, who it was for, and the stand-ups in between.

shots.title: A command centre per person
shots.text: What needs each of us today, our agents' reports, and a voice box to brief them: built by our agents, for us.

shots.title: Who reads what, and what the agents did
shots.text: Readers, the team, synthetic visitors, crawlers and every agent run, hour by hour, decrypted in your browser from an encrypted vault.

picks.title: Many agents, one newsroom: how they avoid collisions
picks.summary: Dozens of agents write, build and check the newsroom at once; seven simple habits keep them apart.

picks.title: Three mistakes our agents made, and the rules they left

picks.title: The newsroom four days out, in pictures
picks.summary: What is live, what the agent desks found, what is next and what waits on a person.
